newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Cullinan reviewing sale of electrical unit.
newsitem.headline: Cullinan reviewing sale of electrical unit.

text.p: Cullinan Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it was re-evaluating the disposal of its electrical division after the buyer said its board of directors had delayed the passing of a resolution to approve the purchase.
Cullinan announced last week that it had disposed of its electrical division to a buyer it did not identify.

Cullinan said the board of directors of the buyer informed it that the passing of a resolution to approve the purchase had been delayed. The delay was not related to the electrical division but circumstances which had previously not been disclosed to Cullinan.
Shareholders were urged to exercise caution in their share dealings.
